title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
Job Title: Automation Test Engineer - API UI Automation Experience: 6-8 Years Job Summary We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer with 6-8 years of experience in designing and implementing automation frameworks for both UI and API testing . The candidate should have strong expertise in Playwright and a solid understanding of modern automation practices . This role involves building scalable test automation solutions, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring overall product quality and stability across complex systems. Key Responsibilities Automation Framework Development Design, develop, and maintain robust, reusable, and scalable automation frameworks using Playwright (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred). Develop end-to-end test automation for both web UI and REST API layers . Integrate automation frameworks with BDD tools like Cucumber for behavior-driven development. Maintain backward compatibility and optimize scripts for execution speed and parallelization. Ensure automation frameworks support execution across multiple environments and browsers. Testing Execution Automate and execute UI test cases for responsive web applications using Playwright. Automate API validation using Postman, RestAssured, or Karate , validating responses, payloads, and performance. Work with DevOps teams to integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions . Create and maintain test data and perform test result analysis and defect logging using Jira or equivalent tools. Continuously improve coverage for regression, smoke, and performance testing. Collaboration Quality Governance Collaborate with developers, BAs, and product teams to define acceptance criteria and automation priorities. Participate in Agile ceremonies - sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily standups - to align QA strategy. Perform code reviews , peer testing, and provide feedback on quality improvements. Contribute to automation best practices , process documentation, and internal QA knowledge base. Required Skills Experience 6-8 years of experience in software testing with strong focus on automation (UI API) . Hands-on expertise with Playwright for web UI automation (JavaScript/TypeScript preferred). Strong understanding of Cucumber (BDD) and Gherkin syntax for scenario-based testing. Proficiency in API automation using tools like RestAssured, Postman, or Karate DSL . Knowledge of Java / TypeScript / JavaScript / Python for script development. Experience with version control (Git) and defect tracking tools (Jira, Zephyr) . Experience in continuous testing and CI/CD integration with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions. Familiarity with test reporting frameworks like Allure , Extent Reports , or Cucumber HTML Reports . Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies . Good to Have / Preferred Skills Experience with Selenium WebDriver or Cypress as a secondary automation tool. Exposure to API mocking and contract testing using WireMock or Pact . Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling . Familiarity with Docker for containerized test execution. Knowledge of cloud-based test execution platforms (e.g., BrowserStack, Sauce Labs). Education Certifications Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field . Certifications in Playwright, Selenium, or ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer preferred. Soft Skills Excellent analytical and debugging skills. Strong communication and documentation abilities. Ability to work collaboratively across development and QA teams. Passion for automation excellence and continuous improvement . 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
